 A U.S. Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker refuels an F-16 Fighting Falcon assigned to a four-ship formation en route to Eareckson Air Station, Alaska, during Operation NOBLE DEFENDER, Oct. 18, 2026. Through operations from dispersed locations, NOBLE DEFENDER strengthens the ability to rapidly position and sustain forces, integrate defensive capabilities, and deter potential threats to North America. (U.S. Air Force Photo by Capt. Joseph Harazim)
